summary: Extends IPv6 stateless address autoconfiguration so an address can use randomly generated, changing identifiers instead of one based on a hardware address. This makes it harder to track a device by its address. It is on the standards track. It was replaced by RFC 4941.

eli5.summary: Wearing the same name tag everywhere makes you easy to follow. This lets a computer change its tag often. A newer document later replaced it.

questions: how to stop ipv6 address tracking
